name: ShoeMaster
tagline: Specialised footwear CAD for patterns and lasts
about: ShoeMaster is a dedicated footwear CAD platform. I use it to draft precise 2D patterns, grade sizes and work with standard last data, bridging the gap between design sketches and production-ready patterns.

name: Rhinoceros (Rhino 3D)
about: I model freeform 3D surfaces and footwear silhouettes in Rhino, exploring form, proportion and volume before any physical prototype is made.

name: Adobe Illustrator
tagline: Clean technical flats and vector design
about: Illustrator is my go-to for vector-based technical drawings, flat sketches, colourways and presentation boards that stay crisp at any scale.

name: Adobe Photoshop
about: I use Photoshop to render materials and textures over sketches, clean up scans and build moodboards and marketing visuals for projects.

name: Canva
tagline: Fast presentation and social media design
about: Canva helps me turn project work into clean presentations, portfolio pages and social media graphics quickly and consistently.

name: Sketching & Rendering
tagline: Hand sketching that starts every idea
about: Every design begins on paper. I sketch silhouettes and details by hand and render them to communicate form, material and mood early in the process.

name: Concept Development
tagline: From brief and moodboards to strong concepts
about: I develop concepts by researching trends, building moodboards and defining a clear design story before translating it into a product direction.

name: Prototyping
about: I build physical and digital prototypes to test fit, comfort and construction, refining the design through hands-on iterations.

name: Pattern Making
tagline: Technical patterns that make a design real
about: I create and manipulate patterns that transform a 3D design into the flat pieces needed for cutting and assembly in production.

name: 3D Printing
tagline: Fast physical models from digital files
about: I use 3D printing to produce quick physical models of components and forms, validating proportion and detailing early in development.

name: Material Knowledge
tagline: Selecting the right materials for the job
about: I understand how leathers, synthetics, foams and soling materials behave, so each design balances durability, comfort and aesthetic.
